settlementRules.description:
In the upcoming NFL football game between Browns and Steelers, scheduled for November 1 at 1:00PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Browns" if Browns win the game.
This market will resolve to "Steelers" if Steelers win the game.
Overtime is included if played.
If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

In the upcoming NFL football game between Eagles and Commanders, scheduled for November 1 at 8:20PM ET:
This market will resolve to "Eagles" if Eagles win the game.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
